findings.title: Item-resume flags can be combined with incompatible command modes
findings.description: `check_item_flags` validates the item-specific flags, but does not reject combinations such as `--resume ID --item N --decision retry --dry-run`. The `--dry-run` branch runs before item resume and asserts that a pipeline argument is present; with this invocation, that assertion fails instead of producing a clear usage error. Other modes, such as `--prompt-only`, can likewise divert execution. Reject incompatible mode flags when item-resume flags are present.

findings.title: A failed design review can make a planning item impossible to retry
findings.description: `_select_item` requires the item to be returned by reevaluating its source. For `slices-plan`, that source is `cf.undesigned_slices`, which stops returning a slice once its first attempt has created a design file. Thus, when that attempt is flagged for an unresolved review, a later `--decision retry` rejects the item as no longer selected, rather than rerunning it. The source selection or resume logic needs to account for this expected post-attempt state.

findings.title: Mutating steps inside fan-out can bypass the project run lock
findings.description: Mutation detection recurses through `config["steps"]` but does not inspect a fan-out step’s `inner` configuration. Since fan-out supports an inner step, a pipeline with a mutating step there can be classified as non-mutating and execute without the checkout lock. Inspect the fan-out inner step when determining whether the pipeline mutates.
